[Privacy]{.eyebrow}

# How we use this website

<p>This page explains how The Upwelling Project website handles analytics and cookies.</p>
:::
:::

::: {.section}
::: {.section__inner .section__inner--narrow}
[Analytics]{.eyebrow}

<h2 class="section__title">Google Analytics</h2>

<p class="section__lead">We use <a href="https://analytics.google.com/" target="_blank" rel="noopener">Google Analytics 4</a> to understand how people find and use this site — for example, which pages are viewed, roughly where visitors are located, and what devices they use.</p>

<p class="section__lead">That helps us improve the information we publish about the award and the application process. We do not use analytics to identify you personally or to build advertising profiles.</p>

<ul class="checklist">
  <li>Data is collected in aggregate form (general traffic patterns, not individual tracking for marketing).</li>
  <li>IP addresses are anonymised before they are stored in Google Analytics.</li>
  <li>Analytics cookies are only set if you accept cookies in the banner on this site.</li>
</ul>
:::
:::

::: {.section .section--surface}
::: {.section__inner .section__inner--narrow}
[Cookies]{.eyebrow}

<h2 class="section__title">Cookie consent</h2>

<p class="section__lead">When you first visit, you can accept or decline optional cookies used for analytics. You can change your choice at any time using <strong>Cookie preferences</strong> in the banner or site footer area.</p>

<p class="section__lead">If you decline, Google Analytics will not use cookies on your device. Analytics cookies are not used unless you accept.</p>
:::
:::

::: {.section}
::: {.section__inner .section__inner--narrow}
[Questions]{.eyebrow}

<h2 class="section__title">Contact</h2>

<p class="section__lead">If you have questions about privacy and this website, email us at <a href="mailto:hello@theupwellingproject.org">hello@theupwellingproject.org</a>.</p>
